title: Who controls trespass footage? Here’s what the High Court’s answer means for animals – and press freedom
paragraphs: Who gets to see what happens in slaughterhouses? The answer is: officials, sometimes, but almost never the public.

In a landmark case, the High Court of Australia has ruled an abattoir cannot use copyright law to control who sees video – allegedly depicting animal cruelty – that was illegally recorded on its property.
But on the facts of this case, the activists who trespassed to film the video were ordered to destroy their copies.
